1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
opennyai_summary.15_February_2024__arguments:
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code as well as Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
It is further submitted that despite notice being validly served on the opposite party no. 2 she chooses not to contest the case.
It is next submitted that the opposite party no. 2 has lost interest in the case for the reason that she has performed her second Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.16593 of 2023(5) dt.15-02-2024 marriage but then the petitioner is not aware of the name of the second husband of the opposite party no. 2.
4.
Learned A.P.P. for the State, at this stage, submits that a false statement has been made when no such fact has been pleaded in the anticipatory bail application on which learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner seeks two weeks time for filing a supplementary affidavit.
opennyai_summary.15_February_2024__decision:
5. Put up this case on 11.03.2024.
In the meantime, the interim protection granted to the petitioner, vide order dated 29.05.2023,
shall continue.

opennyai_summary.final__arguments: The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code as well as Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
opennyai_summary.final__decision:
Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner, the petitioner above-named, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/-
(Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/successor court in connection with Complaint Case No. C49 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
6.
However, the opposite party no. 2 shall be at liberty Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.16593 of 2023(6) dt.14-03-2024 to file an application seeking cancellation of the anticipatory bail granted to the petitioner in the event if the anticipatory bail has been obtained by the petitioner based on misleading facts.
